paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum sawm-le-khatna, akha thumna, huai kha ani khat ni in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
heading: Aigupta, Sidar Sing Toh Tehpih Ahi
english: In the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh leh akhua leh amite kiang ah gen inla: Na thupina ah kua toh na kibang a ahia?
english: “Son of man, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt and his multitude: ‘Whom are you like in your greatness?

paite: "Ngai in, Assuria tuh Lebanon a sidar ahi a, hiang kilawm leh bawkpha, lim sah, sang kilawm, mei lak ah adawn a-om hi.
english: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs.

paite: Tui in ahon vak a, tui thuk in akhangsak hulhul, aphuhna luite'n aluan kual ua, gam sing chih vakna ding in aluangsak hi.
english: The waters nourished it. The deep made it to grow. Its rivers ran all around its plantation. It sent out its channels to all the trees of the field.

paite: Huchi in gam sing teng zou in asang tuan a; tuite akidaih zoh ziak in akungpite khanglian in, ahiangte asau ua amengkhesak hi.
english: Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field; and its boughs were multiplied. Its branches became long by reason of many waters, when it spread them out.

paite: Ahiang ah tungleng vasate'n bu abawl ua; ahiang nuai ah sa chiteng in nou anei ua; alimnuai ah nam thupi teng ateng uhi.
english: All the birds of the sky made their nests in its boughs. Under its branches, all the animals of the field gave birth to their young. All great nations lived under its shadow.

paite: Huchi in athupina ah akilawm a, ahiangte sauna bang zel in; azungte lah tui tampite kiang ah a-om ngal a,
english: Thus it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches; for its root was by many waters.

paite: Pathian huan a sidar singte'n aphazou kei ua; abawk, meilah sing in adem zou kei a; ahiang sesing in aphazou sam kei; akilawmna ah Pathian huan a sing abang zou kei hi.
english: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it. The cypress trees were not like its branches. The pine trees were not like its branches; nor was any tree in the garden of God like it in its beauty.

paite: Ahiang tamsak in ka bawlhoih a, Pathian huan a Eden sing teng in ahaza uhi," chi in.
english: I made it beautiful by the multitude of its branches, so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied it.’

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Ahong san mahmah a, meipi lak a adawn alen a, alungtang a asandan akisaktheihpih ziak in,
english: “Therefore thus said the Lord Yahweh: ‘Because he is exalted in stature, and he has set his top among the thick branches, and his heart is lifted up in his height,

paite: namte lak ah mihattak khut ah ka mansak ding a; athulimlouhdan bang in agawt ding a, ka delhkhe ding.
english: I will deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations. He will surely deal with him. I have driven him out for his wickedness.

paite: Huchi in gamdangmi, namte lak a kihtakhuai mahmahte'n aphuk ding ua, anuse ding uh; tangte, phaizangte ah ahiangte ake lemlum ding a, huai gam tuiluanna phaizang tengteng ah ahiangte akitan lemlum ding; leitung a mi tengteng alimnuai a kipan apawtkhe ding ua, amah apaisan ding uh.
english: Foreigners, the tyrants of the nations, have cut him off and have left him. His branches have fallen on the mountains and in all the valleys, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land. All the peoples of the earth have gone down from his shadow and have left him.

paite: Asiatna ah tungleng vasa tengteng ateng ding ua, abawk tung ah gamsate a-om ding uh.
english: All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches,

paite: Hiai bel tui a vak sing tengteng akisansak louh ua, adawn uh meipi kal a lengsak lou a, tui a vak sing in asandan uh asuan samlouhna ding uh ahi; lei mun nuainungpen a kokhuk a paisukta, mihing tate lak ah pai ding in, sihna a matsak ahi vekta ngal ua."
english: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, and don’t set their top among the thick boughs. Their mighty ones don’t stand up on their height, even all who drink water; for they are all delivered to death, to the lower parts of the earth, among the children of men, with those who go down to the pit.’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Sheol a apaisuk ni in amah ka sunsak a, luitui thuktakte ka khawlsak a; huai ah tui tampi let dingte ka daltan a; Lebanon amah ka sunsak lai a; gam sing tengteng amah ziak in agim khin uhi.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘In the day when he went down to Sheol, I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its rivers. The great waters were stopped. I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

paite: Namte leng apuk ging ah ka lingsak a, kokhuk a paisuksate kiang a Sheol a ka paihkhiak ni in; Eden sing tengteng, Lebanon sing hoih tata, tui a vak tengteng lei nuainungpen ah lungmuang in a-omta uhi.
english: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with those who descend into the pit. All the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.

paite: Namsau a thahte kiang ah Sheol ah apaisuk ua; ahi, namte lak a, alimnuai a tengte leh namte lak a akizoppihte toh hankhuk atungsuk uhi."
english: They also went down into Sheol with him to those who are slain by the sword; yes, those who were his arm, who lived under his shadow in the middle of the nations.

paite: "Thupina leh letna ah Eden singte lak a kua ahia nang bang om? Himahleh Eden singte toh lei mun nuainungpen ah paihkhiak na hi ding; namsau a thah, zeksumlouhte lak ah na lum ding hi. Hiai bel Pharaoh leh akhua-le-tuite ahi uh," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “‘To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth. You will lie in the middle of the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword. “‘This is Pharaoh and all his multitude,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”
